content.text:
Acceptance report for Logomocja, tested in headless Chromium against http://localhost:4173/ and the 4174 sub-path server. Screenshots are in `/tmp/review/ui/`. Nothing under `/work` was modified. The built `dist/` predates only `src/lang/limits.ts` and `src/lang/parser.ts`, so none of the UI findings are affected.

## (A) Broken or missing required features

**A1. [major] A 2D permalink opens with the drawing shrunk to a speck.**
- **Repro:** In a fresh browser context open `http://localhost:4173/#/?tryb=2d&kod=zNcdBCsIwEAXQ_ZziU7ciSStB8RAeoHQxiSKl0gnTSCAX6IE8gh5MGnD33gVXr5_3d8WU-aacMKKI51D2CI` (any link from the Link dialog behaves the same). The same happens at 1920x1080 and 390x800.
- **Expected:** the program loads, runs, and the drawing is fitted to the view.
- **Actual:** it loads and runs, but the view is at about ±4000 scale and a 120-unit square is about 30x70 px. The user has to press "Dopasuj widok".
- **Screenshots:** `26-b-fresh-permalink.png`, `28-sheet.png`.
- **Likely cause** (from `view/common.ts`): while the studio is hidden or not yet laid out, `resize()` clamps to 40x40 and consumes the `first` flag. The first fit therefore uses 40x40, and the later real resize does not refit.

**A2. [major] The same missing fit hits several other entry points.**
- **Repro:**
  - Examples gallery, click "Wczytaj" on any 2D example.
  - Polecenia page, click any "Wypróbuj (2D)".
  - Open the site at `#/polecenia`, `#/przyklady` or `#/wyzwania`, then click "Pracownia". This also affects 3D: the cube is tiny.
  - `window.logomocja.open(...)` when the page was loaded at one of those routes.
- **Actual:** the drawing is a speck. For the hook, the drawing measured 32x70 px, against 590x588 px when the page is loaded at `/`.
- **Expected:** the hook contract says the view is fitted so the whole drawing is visible.
- **Screenshots:** `18-sheet.png`, `19-sheet.png`, `20-sheet.png`; the hook case was measured with `/tmp/tools/qa_60.mjs`.

**A3. [major] Phone usability: the editor collapses to zero height.**
- **Repro:** emulate a touch device.
- **Actual:**
  - 390x470 (soft keyboard open): editor height is 0, so nothing being typed is visible. `39-keyboard-open.png`.
  - 320x600: editor is 24 px tall. `37-320x600.png`.
  - 800x390 (landscape phone): the same stacked layout, editor height 0, and the bottom nav overlaps the file bar. `40-landscape-800x390.png`.
- **Expected:** a usable editor on a phone. Only 390x800 works acceptably.
- **Suggestion:** collapse or hide the header, view or nav while the editor is focused or the viewport is short.

## (B) Bugs and rough edges

**B1. [major] 3D animated run: the turtle and drawing are off-screen for the first seconds.**
- **Repro:** switch to 3D, set the speed to "Wolno", press Uruchom on the default cube. Or run Helisa at "Szybko".
- **Actual:** the camera starts at a very close default. The view is blank at 0–1 s, shows fragments until about 3–5 s, and only then frames the cube. At "Szybko" the cube finishes in under 1 s and the first half second is blank.
- **Expected:** the camera follows the growing drawing, as the 2D view does.
- **Screenshots:** `50-sheet.png`, `49-sheet.png`, `48-sheet2.png`.

**B2. [minor] The empty or tiny 3D scene uses that same close-up camera.**
- **Repro:** in 3D clear the editor or press Reset; or run `np 0` or `np 0.01`.
- **Actual:** axes lines shoot off-screen and the ground grid is almost invisible.
- **Screenshots:** `35-empty-editor.png`, `12-sheet3d.png`.

**B3. [minor] Fit fails for very large drawings; the hint overlaps axis labels.**
- **Fit:** `np 90000 pw 90 np 5000` is allowed (limit ±100,000) but "fit" cannot show it. `MIN_SCALE` is 0.01 px per unit, so anything over about 69,000 units is cut off and the origin is off-screen. `12-huge.png`.
- **Overlap:** the bottom hint text overlaps the x-axis labels when the axis sits at the bottom edge (`pod np 5000 opu np 10`). `12-sheet.png`.

**B4. [minor] Challenge page is cramped.**
- **Desktop:**
  - At 1360x800 the task panel clips its text mid-line with no scroll cue ("Podpowiedzi" is cut in half). The verdict box then squeezes the description further. `23-b-detail.png`, `23-c-fail.png`, `45-c-dark-challenge.png`.
  - The editor is only about 10 lines tall.
- **Phone:** on 390x800 the view is about 180 px tall and the two-row floating toolbar covers the turtle and drawing. `55-challenge-390.png`.

**B5. [minor] The floating view toolbar covers the top of the drawing on phones.**
- **Repro:** on the default 390x800 layout, the square's top edge sits under the toolbar. The fit margin does not account for the overlay.
- **Screenshot:** `53-390-default.png`.

**B6. [minor] Reference snippets fill the "Szkice" stash and can evict real drafts.**
- **Repro:** click "Wypróbuj" repeatedly on the Polecenia page.
- **Actual:** each click stashes the previous snippet and shows a toast, because snippets are not recognised as pristine examples. `STASH_MAX` is 12, so a real draft stashed earlier is silently dropped after 12 further clicks.

**B7. [minor] The permalink stays in the address bar after the Link dialog closes.**
- **Repro:** open Link, close it, edit the program, reload.
- **Actual:** the old shared snapshot loads and the new edit goes to Szkice (with a toast).
- **Expected:** reload restores the latest draft.

**B8. [minor] Invalid permalinks show raw English engine errors.**
- **Actual:**
  - `kod=zzzz%%%` gives "Nie udało się odczytać linku: Failed to execute 'atob' on 'Window'…".
  - A truncated `z…` payload gives "…: Failed to fetch" plus an uncaught `pageerror` "Compressed input was truncated."
- **Expected:** Polish text and no uncaught error.

**B9. [minor] Error-message wording.**
- `np 10 +` and `np 10 - -` report "Polecenie „np" wymaga argumentu" at column 1, although the argument exists and the operand is what is missing.
- A missing argument for `pw` on line 2 is marked on `kolor` in line 3, and the message does not mention line 2. `51-sheet.png`, `45-a-dark-error.png`.
- The repeat-count message mixes "10 000" and "100000".

**B10. [minor] Small layout shifts and truncation.**
- Long error text makes the status bar grow from 1 to 3 lines, which resizes the editor. It is clamped with "…", so part of the message is lost there, though the inline marker still shows it.
- Pause to Wznów changes the button width and nudges the speed slider by 10 px.

**B11. [minor] Download file names are stale, and an empty export gives no warning.**
- **Repro:** load example "Kula", replace the text with something else, then use PNG or Pobierz.
- **Actual:** the files are still named `kula-3d.png` and `kula-3d.logo`.
- **PNG:** exporting an empty drawing downloads a blank white PNG with a success toast. `dl/empty.png`.

**B12. [minor] Dropping a file outside the workspace navigates away.**
- **Repro:** drop a `.logo` file on the header or on another page.
- **Actual:** the drop is not prevented, so the browser would navigate away. Inside the workspace, drag and drop works well.

**B13. [minor] Editor ergonomics.**
- Tab leaves the editor, so there is no indent.
- Enter does not auto-indent.
- Ctrl+Z does nothing after an example load; the "Cofnij" toast covers that case.
- The "Cofnij" toast lasts 9 s and sits last in the tab order, so keyboard users can barely reach it.

**B14. [minor] Challenge feedback.**
- A mirrored answer or a wrong side count gets only "Rysunek wygląda zupełnie inaczej niż wzór (22,4%)".
- The "rozwiązane" toast repeats on every re-check.
- "Wróć" on a solved card is ambiguous.
- Resetting progress uses a native `confirm()`.

**B15. [info] Sub-path hosting.**
- **4174 server:** it serves the `/`-built `dist/` from a sub-path. It works through the relative fallback, but each load logs two 404s plus console errors for the absolute `/assets/…` URLs. Route navigation, reload, deep links and the hook all work.
- **BASE_PATH build:** I built a copy with `BASE_PATH=/Logomocja/builds/x/` under `/tmp` and served it. It was clean, with no 404s, no console output and no external requests.

## (C) Visual and UX polish suggestions
- The 3D turtle marker is about 20 px at default framing and easy to miss; it reads well when the drawing is large.
- There are no 3D preset views (top/front). Flat programs only look identical to 2D after manually orbiting top-down.
- In 2D, "Dopasuj widok" and "Resetuj widok" do the same thing.
- No indicator shows an off-screen origin.
- At 1024 px and below, Krok, Reset, Link and PNG lose their labels (tooltip only). "Zacznij od nowa" looks like plain text, not a button.
- Toasts stack up to four and cover the status bar and the bottom of the editor.
- The reference page table of contents has no current-section highlight.
- Esc in the editor wipes the drawing, which may surprise users.
- A parse error found while typing leaves the previous run's drawing on screen.

## (D) Notably good
- Editor overlay and caret are pixel-aligned, including tabs, Polish letters and emoji. Highlighting covers the whole dialect and error markers land on the right column.
- All 13 examples and all 11 challenges work with correct modes, and challenge progress and drafts persist.
- axe-core reported 0 violations on 5 routes in light and dark. Focus rings, Tab order, dialog trapping and Esc handling are all correct.
- Animation holds a steady 60 fps, and the app makes no external requests and logs no console errors in normal use.

content.text:
Logomocja is built and working in `/work`: both modes, all eleven features, the thirteen standard programs and the delivery contract. `bun run build` produces `dist/`, `BASE_PATH` works, `window.logomocja` has `version`, `run` and `open`, and `bun run test` passes (121 tests). I also ran it in headless Chromium at desktop, tablet and phone sizes, light and dark. The checks covered the permalink, PNG and `.logo` flows, challenges, shortcuts, persistence and sub-path hosting. A built-in accessibility checker found no violations on any page.

- **No dependencies.** There is nothing to install and no network is needed at runtime. The bundle is about 150 kB.
- **3D without WebGL.** The 3D view is drawn on a normal 2D canvas with a perspective camera, so it works wherever 2D does. That means there is never a "3D is off" state to explain; the reference page says so.
- **BASE_PATH.** I built with `BASE_PATH=/Logomocja/builds/x/`. It loaded under that sub-path with no 404s and no external requests, and reloading a route worked. If the files are served from somewhere other than `BASE_PATH`, a fallback loads them relative to the page instead.
- **Draft safety.** Loading an example, file or link over your own text stores the old text in "Szkice" and shows an Undo button.
- **Challenges.** There are 11 (8 in 2D, 3 in 3D). Failures say what is wrong, including when the shape is right but mirrored, rotated or in the wrong place.

I also had two independent review agents work through the interpreter and the UI, and fixed what they found:
- **Spec conformance.** I removed my own 200-level cap on nested parentheses, which the spec does not have. A parameter that shares a name with a procedure can now be reassigned.
- **UI fixes.**
  - Drawings now fit correctly when opened from a permalink, the gallery or the reference page.
  - The editor stays usable on short and narrow phone screens.
  - A few messages and permalink errors were reworded.

Where the spec left a choice open, I picked one and documented it in `docs/language.md`. The main ones:
- A missing `już` is reported at the `oto` that was never closed.
- An unclosed `[` or `(` is reported at the opening bracket.
- An error inside a condition points at the operand that has the problem, not at the start of the whole condition.

Those are the places a different test suite is most likely to disagree.

`bun run e2e` is an optional browser smoke test; it needs Playwright, which I did not add as a dependency. Start with `README.md`.
